hypothesis: A multi-modal ILC-specific early detection and treatment monitoring panel is now constructable from three convergent lines of 2022-2026 evidence: (1) Personalized ctDNA (Signatera tumor-informed 16-plex PCR-NGS) is clinically validated in metastatic ILC (n=66, 355 plasma samples; ctDNA dynamics predict CDK4/6 response, JCO Precis Oncol 2025). (2) ILC ctDNA has a genomically distinct profile from IDC (121 ILC vs 792 IDC via Guardant360™, n=980; EBioMedicine 2022) — ILC-specific alterations include CDH1 loss, FOXA1 mutations, and distinct CNV patterns. (3) Two novel tissue-level ILC biosignatures from 2026 — ferroptosis FRGS (TCGA+METABRIC+GEO n=490) and spatial TME subtypes (PNAS, n=43) — identify ILC-specific molecular vulnerabilities not captured by standard HR+/HER2- classification. The actionable synthesis: the ILC-specific ctDNA genomic fingerprint (CDH1, FOXA1, FRGS-associated genes) should be validated as a non-personalized, population-level early detection panel — moving beyond the current 'tumor-informed personalized' paradigm toward a universal ILC screening assay. The FRGS ferroptosis gene set provides candidate methylation markers for ctDNA enrichment in early-stage ILC where tumor-informed personalization requires prior tissue biopsy.

evidence.claim: Personalized ctDNA (Signatera 16-plex PCR-NGS) in 66 mILC patients (355 plasma samples): ctDNA dynamics correlate with treatment response; 92% of ctDNA-decrease patients showed clinical benefit vs 31% of ctDNA-increase patients.
evidence.role: bridge_evidence — proves ILC ctDNA feasibility and clinical utility

evidence.claim: Guardant360™ ctDNA in 121 ILC vs 792 IDC patients: ILC has distinct ctDNA molecular landscape including CDH1 loss-of-function, FOXA1 alterations, and different CNV patterns vs IDC — ILC-specific ctDNA fingerprint is characterizable.

FRGS ferroptosis gene signature across 490 ILC patients identifies 2 molecular subtypes with distinct TME and mutation profiles — FRGS genes are candidates for methylation-based ctDNA marker development.
evidence.role: novel_biosignature — tissue-level, translatable to methylation ctDNA

evidence.claim: Spatial TME subtypes (immune-cold vs immune-hot) in HR+/HER2- ILC predict differential treatment response — spatial subtype-defining transcripts are candidates for cfRNA panel.
Recruiting trial (n=20): longitudinal ctDNA burden quantification in metastatic ILC — clinical community already pursuing ILC-specific ctDNA monitoring.
evidence.role: clinical_validation — confirms approach is considered feasible

evidence.claim: PALMARES-2: CDK4/6 inhibitor effectiveness differs by histology (ILC vs IDC) in real-world Italian multicenter cohort — ILC-specific treatment stratification is clinically needed.

novelty_claim: The non-personalized population-level ILC ctDNA screening concept is novel. All current ILC ctDNA work (NCT06666439, PMID 40324116) uses tumor-informed personalized assays requiring prior tissue biopsy — inapplicable for population screening. No paper has proposed using FRGS ferroptosis methylation marks as a tumor-agnostic ILC enrichment layer in cfDNA to enable biopsy-free early detection.
actionability: Experiment A (immediate, in silico): Extract FRGS gene list from Liu et al. supplementary. Query TCGA WGBS (whole genome bisulfite seq) and GEO cfDNA datasets for differential methylation of FRGS loci in ILC vs IDC samples. Test whether methylation signature is detectable in existing cfDNA data. Experiment B (ClinicalTrials): Propose NCT collaboration with NCT06666439 (recruiting, n=20) to add FRGS methylation profiling to their Signatera protocol — minimal protocol amendment. Experiment C (hypothesis_generation task): Use the ILC-specific ctDNA fingerprint (CDH1, FOXA1, FRGS) as input to /hypothesis-gen to generate mechanistically novel CDK4/6 response prediction hypotheses.
candidate_biomarkers: FOXA1 mutations — ILC-enriched in ctDNA vs IDC (PMID 36332363)
FRGS ferroptosis gene methylation — novel, tissue evidence (PMID 41815159), translation to ctDNA proposed
TME spatial subtype transcripts (immune-cold vs immune-hot) — cfRNA candidates (PMID 41637449)
Personalized 16-plex tumor-informed panel (Signatera) — validated for monitoring in mILC (PMID 40324116)
